questions.question: What refrain runs through Psalm 107 about those who cried to the LORD in trouble?
options: He hid his face from their troubles
He repaid them for their many sins
He scattered them among all the nations
He delivered them from their distress
questions.answer: He delivered them from their distress

questions.question: Which groups of redeemed people does Psalm 107 describe?
options: Wanderers, prisoners, the sick, and sailors in storms
Mighty kings, high priests, prophets, and judges of Israel
The proud, the rich, the strong, and the wise
questions.answer: Wanderers, prisoners, the sick, and sailors in storms

questions.question: The psalm repeatedly urges thanks to the LORD for his steadfast love and wondrous works.
Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his steadfast love endures _____!
He stilled the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were _____.
